title: Project Organica — a developmental-structure engine and its preregistered evidence record
description: Project Organica is a Python engine that grows a graph of typed structural candidates across sleep cycles and can revise them under later evidence. The engine itself (`organica/`) is frozen at v0.9.0 and is not modified by later work; the repository additionally carries the preregistered evidence record: the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines (Phase K), the plasticity-coherence sweep (Phase L), the acquisition-benchmark audits, the Gate 13 relation-ranking analyses, and the formation-versus-utilization campaign. The engine uses only the Python standard library. The version of each Zenodo record is the GitHub release tag it was minted from.
notes: Organica 1 is frozen at v0.9.0: the engine under the v0.10.0 tag is byte-identical to the v0.9.0 tag apart from the package version string, and the v0.9.0 tag remains the archival reference for the engine alone. v0.10.0 is the release of the research package around that engine -- the instruments, the evidence artifacts and the two preprint manuscripts -- and none of it modifies the engine.
